description: A long destination "in my own words", over the region cap.

request.message: Two adults flying from New York in September 2030 for 10 nights, beach and museums. Where we want to go, in my exact words, please keep all of it as the destination: a quiet stretch of the Amalfi Coast in Italy, somewhere between Positano and Ravello, with lemon groves above the sea, narrow stairways down to small pebble beaches, family-run trattorias on the cliffs, ferries to Capri in the morning, and a terrace where we can watch the fishing boats come back at sunset while the church bells ring across the bay, LANTERN-CANARY-63
